title: Shape V2 Retrofit Path-Prefix Bug Audit
description: Audit already-CLOSED Shape V2 tree-purity retrofit tickets (26/08/05/*-SHAPE-V2-TREE-PURITY-RETROFIT) for the confirmed #[path] double-prefix bug (grouping-module `#[path="."]` resets wrongly getting a `../../` prefix during the retrofit — only LEAF paths should get that prefix). Discovered by sourcing's retrofit via a real compiler error; TEMPLATE.md lead section point 1 + §14 step 3 now corrected. Real-compile-audit every closed retrofit (isolated `[workspace]` overlay + `cargo check --manifest-path`, per TEMPLATE §3), prioritizing plugins whose ticket only had MANUAL verification or were blocked by norm. Fix any found (revert wrongly-prefixed `"."` back to plain `"."`, leave leaf paths prefixed), re-verify with cargo check+clippy+test matching the plugin's recorded baseline. Never touch plugins still mid-migration per master.md's in-flight list. Never edit root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock. Never run git-modifying commands.
summary: Audited every closed Shape V2 tree-purity retrofit ticket for the confirmed #[path] double-prefix bug (grouping-module "." resets wrongly getting a ../../ prefix). Found and fixed TWO variants across 6 plugins: (1) the documented over-prefix bug in NOTE (14 instances) and FORMS (9 instances) — grouping "." resets wrongly written as "../../." reverted to plain "."; (2) a newly-discovered inverse under-prefix variant in PLAYBOOK, IMPERATIVE, DAG, and RASTER — every LEAF #[path] was missing its required ../../ prefix entirely (0 of 16/19/20/27 leaf paths prefixed respectively), added. All 6 fixes verified with a real isolated-overlay cargo check + clippy --all-targets -D warnings + cargo test, each matching its plugin's recorded baseline exactly (note 63/63, forms 88/88, playbook 50/50, imperative 80/80, dag 61/61, raster 57/57). Additionally real-compile-audited BLOCK (102/102), GIS (146/146), MATHEMATICAL (55/55), PROCEDURAL (196/196), SPACE (85/85) — all clean of the path-prefix bug; BLOCK's clippy step was blocked by an unrelated pre-existing clippy::needless_range_loop violation in a shared framework crate (semio-framework-os-kernel-dsl-core), and PROCEDURAL's clippy step surfaced 2 unrelated pre-existing clippy::map_unwrap_or violations in its own app files — both flagged as separate out-of-scope findings (procedural's via a spawned background task) rather than fixed here. Grep-confirmed clean (zero instances of either bug signature) for the remaining closed-ticket plugins: ANIMATE, CAD, ENERGY, FLOW, LAYOUT, LOWPOLY, NORM, PROCESS, PUZZLE, SEQUENCE, SHOOTING, SOURCING, VCS. A final full-tree sweep across all 31 currently-V2-shaped plugins under ✏️s/🔌️plugins/ confirmed zero remaining instances of either bug variant repo-wide. Did not touch REASONING/WRITER (retrofit tickets still open) or fem/architect/remodel/trinity/draw/demonstrator (still mid-migration/in-flight per master.md), though grep already shows them clean too where V2 lib.rs exists. All temporary verification overlays, nested target/ dirs, and Cargo.lock files were removed after use; every touched Cargo.toml was diffed back to its pre-overlay content. Never touched root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, never ran git-modifying commands.
